LLM auditresponse for PKGBUILD:
<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
The PKGBUILD is a standard AUR package definition for `vi-mongo` (MongoDB TUI manager). It follows conventional packaging practices without any indicators of compromise. The source URLs point to the official GitHub repository (https://github.com/rafaeldominiquini/vi-mongo), which is the expected upstream location for this open-source project. The package provides valid SHA256 checksums for both x86_64 and aarch64 architectures, ensuring integrity verification. The build process simply installs the compiled binary and associated documentation using standard `install` commands with appropriate permission flags (-Dm755 for the binary, -Dm644 for text files). There are no obfuscated code sections, suspicious network operations, or attempts to execute external scripts beyond the standard build workflow. The `options=("!strip")` directive is a common optimization to remove debug symbols from binaries, which is perfectly legitimate for distribution packages. Overall, this is a well-structured, secure package that adheres to AUR conventions and contains no malicious behavior.
</details>
<evidence></evidence>
